body:
An agent reviews a release's inspection, meaning what the build read and the package check, and reports the risks in plain language. For example: "reads `SOLACE_CONFIG` but nothing sets it in the package".

- The human sees the report with the release on the Build tab.
- The human can file a task from any finding.

Done when: a release whose build read something its package doesn't carry gets a report naming that risk in plain words, and a task can be filed from that finding.
title: inspection: agent risk report
